note: Both sets contain the same seven claims with the same values, bindings and supporting quotes, and all are faithful to the page. The only substantive difference is that Set A keeps the condition 'Section 6' on the two polar-mix ratio claims, which is needed to bind the 30%/70% mix to the polars used in the aeroelastic simulations, while Set B drops it. Both sets also omit several notable facts on the page (360-degree polars extrapolated with AirfoilPreppy, the Snel and Du-Selig 3D corrections, the EllipSys2D CFD basis), so the omission is shared and does not separate them.
remarks: The two sets are near-identical apart from the dropped 'Section 6' condition and trivial unit formatting ('30%' vs '30 %'). Facts both sets miss: full 360-degree polars extrapolated with AirfoilPreppy, no 3D flow correction in the WindIO/report airfoil data, Snel 3D correction default in HAWC2, Du-Selig 3D correction in the OpenFAST airfoil input files, and the EllipSys2D 2D CFD basis for the airfoil data.
